name: Korean Beef Bulgogi Tacos with Creamy Cabbage-Mango Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 mango
1 (2 inch) piece ginger root
1 lime
½ small bunch green onion (scallion)
½ small bunch cilantro
½ small head red cabbage

instructions.primary_message: Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; small dice the flesh. Divide between two medium bowls, then set one bowl aside for the slaw.
Using a fork or potato masher, mash mango in the remaining bowl until semi-smooth.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the mashed mango.
Add soy sauce, gochujang, sugar, vinegar, salt, and pepper to the bowl, then stir to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp gochujang
7 tsp brown sugar
1 tbsp rice wine vinegar
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat steak dry with paper towels, then slice crosswise into thin strips. Add to the bowl with the marinade, stir to coat, and set aside for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, juice lime into the remaining bowl with the mango. Add sour cream, mayo, additional gochujang, sugar, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup sour cream
2 tbsp mayonnaise
gochujang
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Halve cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the slaw, and set aside.
When the steak is done marinating, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add steak (leaving any excess marinade in the bowl) and stir-fry until cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Transfer steak to a plate.
Meanwhile, warm tortillas in another skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
To serve, divide tortillas between plates, then fill with slaw and beef. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and enjoy!
